description: Put an outfit from a second photo (product shot, flat lay, or worn by someone else; only the clothes are used) onto the person in the first photo. Returns an AI preview image labeled 'AI preview, not a real photo, not exact fit'. Requires consent=true for photo 1 (the user or an adult who agreed). Same content policy and daily limits as photo_tryon; lingerie, swimwear and see-through outfits are not supported. Photos are not stored.

outfit_base64.description: JPEG/PNG, ≤1.5MB, ≤1024px long side recommended. data: URL prefix allowed.

outfit_url.description: Public https URL of the image (alternative to base64).

person_base64.description: JPEG/PNG, ≤1.5MB, ≤1024px long side recommended. data: URL prefix allowed.

person_url.description: Public https URL of the image (alternative to base64).

name: outfit_tryon
title: Outfit try-on from two photos (AI preview)
